scope: Proposition 3.4 (Low-degree correlation) of the manuscript “Constant-factor hardness of Min-UnCut” (preprints/Constant-factor-hardness-of-Min-UnCut-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 102 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3300408a7ae8900e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix J and the constants (3.7)–(3.8). For every m, n ≥ 2 and every finite weighted family of folded proofs satisfying εj ≤ Jbj for j = 1, 2, 3, the field L from (3.10) has Fourier row degree at most Rm and Gaussian degree at most s, satisfies (3.14), and obeys 𝔼𝔡X(L) ≥ 1 4T . (3.18) All constants preceding m, n are uniform in their values and in the affine alphabets.
